reverse expected and observed values or invent missing operand roles from a flattened summary.

assertions or current source, and explain the corrected cause before extending a prior edit.

hypotheses: The extra +1 in positional width and precision lookup selects the following argument, explaining the incorrect padding and integer-conversion errors.
A zero positional width or precision index is not rejected before argument-indexing mode handling, so it produces the automatic/manual indexing diagnostic instead of argument not found.
Overflow and missing-argument behavior for positional star fields depends on the get_arg callback and argument lookup contract.
